title: calibration-job-orchestration-failure-isolation-credential-sanitization-and-snapshot-quarantine-playbook
creator: Maya Fernandez
description: Define an orchestration playbook for calibration job runs in Redwood Console that covers failure isolation, credential/secret sanitization for artifacts, snapshot quarantine for suspicious runs, and accuracy-validation signoff for FP8/INT8 quant profiles. This ticket scopes the product requirements, acceptance criteria, and handoff points for engineering and design. Goal: reduce accidental exposure of secret material in calibration artifacts, provide deterministic rollback/rollback-safety for promoted quant profiles, and add an auditable quarantine path for runs that show unexplained accuracy regression.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Console exposes a configurable quarantine state for calibration run snapshots with a clear audit trail and TTL. 2) Calibration artifacts containing sensitive metadata (KMS ARNs, temporary credentials) are automatically redacted or replaced with references before long-term retention. 3) Runs that fail accuracy validation against the baseline (>= configured delta) are automatically flagged and moved to quarantine; notification to owning team produced. 4) Promotion flow requires explicit reviewer signoff and records reviewer identity in the run artifact metadata. 5) E2E tests (mocked infra) validate quarantine TTL, redaction logic, and promotion/rollback flows.
proposed_flow: - Run creation: user schedules a calibration job (FP8/INT8) with dataset and eval spec. - Preflight: sanitize uploaded artifacts; replace ephemeral credentials with KMS references and insert redaction markers. - Execution: run proceeds; streaming logs and partial artifacts visible to owners. - Accuracy check: post-run evaluation compares metrics to baseline; threshold delta configured per project. - Quarantine decision: if accuracy regression or suspicious artifact contents are detected, snapshot moves to "quarantined" state; TTL timer starts. - Investigation: workspace owners and security team can inspect sanitized artifact references and request deeper export via approval flow. - Promotion: explicit reviewer approves; promotion records immutable approval and moves artifact to "promoted" with longer retention. - Rollback: promoted artifacts have rollback hooks to previous quant profile and telemetry for regression analysis.
retention_policy_summary: Default: ephemeral run snapshots retained for 14 days. Quarantined snapshots retained for 90 days unless manually dismissed. Promoted quant profiles and signed artifacts have 365-day retention with export-escrow options. Artifacts that include customer-provided secrets are retained only as redacted references; raw secret-containing payloads are purged after preflight unless customer opts into private escrow. TTLs configurable per project and overridable by enterprise policy.
access_controls: RBAC: owners and workspace admins can view and act on runs; security-admin role can mark/unmark quarantine. Promotion requires "approver" role. Artifact downloads of non-redacted exports require explicit signed export request tracked in audit log. All artifact access is recorded; KMS-encrypted blobs require corresponding key policy. Console will surface who accessed or requested exports in the run timeline.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: accidental retention of temporary credentials in artifacts. Mitigation: enforce preflight sanitization, block ingest of common credential patterns, redact before storage. Risk: false-positive quarantines that block delivery. Mitigation: allow rapid investigator unquarantine path with accountability and metric capture. Risk: unauthorized promotion. Mitigation: require two-person approval for high-impact promotions and log reviewer identity.
success_metrics: 1) Zero incidents of customer secret leakage from calibration artifacts in next quarter. 2) Mean time to unquarantine decision < 48 hours for flagged runs. 3) 95% of promotions include reviewer metadata. 4) Decrease in manual rollback incidents related to quant profile regressions by 60% after rollout.
